findings.title: The floor plan has no key to its three kinds of desk

location.description: The floor plan card on the right, with the green desks, the white dashed desks and the dark desk E4.

findings.viewer_experience: The viewer has to guess what green, white with a dashed edge and dark teal mean, and cannot tell which desks they could book.

current.value: Three desk styles appear on the plan, and the only hint is the line 18 desks, 3 free at the top right; nothing says which style is free, booked or chosen.

findings.target: A short key or label ties each desk style to its meaning.
findings.fix_direction: Tell the viewer what each desk style means, close to the plan.
findings.source: Nielsen, 10 Usability Heuristics, recognition rather than recall

closed_when.check: Look at the plan and check that something on the card says what green, white dashed and dark desks mean.
